ctx.x: And even up to -- the ratio kept that way, see. The only time that we actually made a little extra money, and it

wasn't that much, because we didn't come out too much on those dates at the Polly Theater. When you figure the transportation, we had to pay for the transportation, and then, when you got back, we would clear after we'd pay your gasoline or your train fare, for somebody to come out here, because Agnes used to come — once we put her on the train, with the luggage and stuff, see. That was $45 round trip. Okay, we paid everybody off, and you're paying union dues out of that, you'd have about $200 left. And the other…
Let's say it this way. We just never got into the big money.
